# Introducing Munich

> > A comprehensive travel guide to Munich, Germany, covering Bavarian culture, historical attractions, and practical visitor information from Oktoberfest to World War history.

Introducing Munich serves as a complete resource for travelers exploring Bavaria's capital city, offering detailed guides on Munich's rich history, cultural landmarks, transportation systems, and accommodation options. The site provides essential information for understanding Munich's evolution from medieval times through the Nazi era to its modern status as a major European city.

## Key Topics

- Munich
- Bavaria
- Oktoberfest
- Bavarian culture
- Nymphenburg Palace
- Dachau Concentration Camp
- World War II history
- Nazi movement
- Old Town Hall
- Theatine Church
- Hofbräuhaus Brewery
- S-Bahn transportation
- Historical attractions
- Germany tourism
- Travel planning

## Essential Munich Guide

- [Munich - Introducing Munich: a travel guide](https://www.introducingmunich.com/): Homepage: Complete Munich travel guide covering Bavarian culture & history
- [Things to Do in Munich - Monuments and tourist attractions](https://www.introducingmunich.com/what-to-see): Munich attractions: monuments, churches, parks, palaces & Oktoberfest

## Accommodation & Hotels

- [Hotels in Munich - Hotel deals in Munich](https://www.introducingmunich.com/hotels): Munich accommodation guide: hotels, hostels, apartments & booking deals

## Transportation

- [Munich S-Bahn - Lines, timetables and prices for Munich trains](https://www.introducingmunich.com/s-bahn): S-Bahn urban rail guide: 8 lines, 150 stations, timetables & prices

## History & Culture

- [History of Munich - Past, present and future of the German city](https://www.introducingmunich.com/history): Munich's history from medieval Bavaria to modern industrial city
